Supreme Court Rebukes Centre Over Disabled Cadets' Benefits

The Supreme Court has rebuked the Central government for its non-compliance with a previous order concerning benefits for disabled officer cadets. The court questioned the government's "scant attitude to court" in implementing the directive. The specific details of the benefits and the previous order were not elaborated upon in the provided coverage.
